intro:
Jewelry, also classified as Magic Sources in the game, amplifies the power of vampire spells.
Higher tiers can also offer other stat bonuses, such as Physical Power. Depending on the item they are crafted either by hand, at the  or the . For spell modifiers see Jewels.
introPt: Jewelry (joalheria) amplifica feitiços vampíricos e pode conceder bônus como Poder Físico. Itens de nível mais alto exigem receitas e estações (Simple Workbench, Artisan Table). Para modificadores de feitiço encaixáveis, veja Joias (spell jewels) tier 1–4.
